places.name: Mysore Palace
places.ai_summary: A historical palace and royal residence, known for its Indo-Saracenic architecture and grandeur.

opening_hours.notes: Illumination on Sundays and public holidays from 7:00 PM to 7:45 PM.

places.place_tip: Visit during the Dussehra festival for a grand experience.
places.address: Mysore Palace, Sayyaji Rao Road, Mysuru, Karnataka, India

wikimedia_commons.source_file: File:A Courtyard of Amba Vilas Palace (Mysuru Palace), during day.jpg

attribution.title: A Courtyard of Amba Vilas Palace (Mysuru Palace), during day
attribution.author: Shashank Mehendale
attribution.description: It is a historical palace and the royal residence at Mysore in Karnataka. It is the official residence of the Wadiyar dynasty and the seat of the Kingdom of Mysore. The palace is located in the centre of Mysuru City.

places.name: Chamundi Hill & Temple
places.ai_summary: A sacred hill with a temple dedicated to Goddess Chamundeshwari, offering panoramic views of Mysuru.

opening_hours.notes: Special poojas during festivals.

places.place_tip: Climb the 1,000 steps for a spiritual experience.
places.address: Chamundi Hill, Mysuru, Karnataka, India

wikimedia_commons.source_file: File:Chamundi Hill view from J.P.Nagar Library, Mysore.jpg

attribution.title: Chamundi Hill view from J.P.Nagar Library, Mysore
attribution.author: Prof tpms

places.name: Brindavan Gardens & Musical Fountain
places.ai_summary: A beautifully landscaped garden with a musical fountain show, located near the Krishnaraja Sagar Dam.

opening_hours.notes: Musical fountain show timings: 6:30 PM - 7:30 PM.

places.place_tip: Stay for the musical fountain show.
places.address: Brindavan Gardens, Mandya District, Karnataka, India

wikimedia_commons.source_file: File:An evening view of Brindavan garden.jpg

attribution.title: An evening view of Brindavan garden
attribution.author: DifferentSimilarities
attribution.description: Lights illuminating the garden in the evening

places.name: St. Philomena’s Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A magnificent cathedral known for its neo-gothic architecture and stunning stained glass windows.

opening_hours.notes: Attend the Sunday mass for a spiritual experience.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the beautiful stained glass artworks.
places.address: St. Philomena’s Church, Mysuru, Karnataka, India

places.name: Mysore Zoo
places.ai_summary: One of the oldest and well-maintained zoos in India, home to a wide variety of animals and birds.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Tuesdays. Last entry at 4:30 PM.

places.place_tip: Visit the tiger and lion enclosures for an exciting experience.
places.address: Mysore Zoo, Mysuru, Karnataka, India

places.name: Jaganmohan Palace Art Gallery
places.ai_summary: An art gallery housed in a palace, featuring traditional and modern Indian art, including works by Raja Ravi Varma.

opening_hours.notes: Photography not allowed inside the gallery.

places.place_tip: Look out for the mesmerizing paintings by Raja Ravi Varma.
places.address: Jaganmohan Palace, Mysuru, Karnataka, India

places.name: Railway Museum Mysore
places.ai_summary: A unique museum showcasing the heritage of Indian Railways with vintage locomotives, carriages, and memorabilia.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Sundays. Last entry at 4:30 PM.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the vintage steam locomotives.
places.address: Railway Museum, Mysuru, Karnataka, India

places.name: Karanji Lake & Park
places.ai_summary: A serene lake and park area, ideal for picnics, boating, and bird watching.

opening_hours.notes: Boating charges extra. Closed during monsoon.

places.place_tip: Enjoy boating and visit the butterfly park.
places.address: Karanji Lake, Mysuru, Karnataka, India

places.name: Ranganathittu Bird Sanctuary
places.ai_summary: A popular bird sanctuary and a paradise for bird watchers, located near the banks of the Kaveri River.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the migratory season (November to March).

places.place_tip: Carry binoculars for bird watching.
places.address: Ranganathittu Bird Sanctuary, Mandya District, Karnataka, India

places.name: Lalitha Mahal Palace
places.ai_summary: A grand palace built in the 19th century, now converted into a luxury hotel, showcasing Indo-Saracenic architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Photography not allowed inside the palace.

places.place_tip: Enjoy high tea at the palace for a royal experience.
places.address: Lalitha Mahal Palace, Mysuru, Karnataka, India

places.name: GRS Fantasy Park
places.ai_summary: A popular amusement park with a variety of rides and attractions for children and adults.

opening_hours.notes: Height restrictions apply for certain rides.

places.place_tip: Visit the water park section for a refreshing experience.
places.address: GRS Fantasy Park, Mysuru, Karnataka, India

places.name: Chamundi Hills Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A scenic viewpoint on Chamundi Hill, offering panoramic views of Mysuru and the surrounding countryside.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Carry a camera for stunning photographs.
places.address: Chamundi Hills Viewpoint, Mysuru, Karnataka, India

places.name: Devaraja Market
places.ai_summary: A vibrant and bustling market in Mysuru, known for its fresh produce, spices, and local handicrafts.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Sundays.

places.place_tip: Experience the local culture and try the street food.
places.address: Devaraja Market, Mysuru, Karnataka, India

places.name: Sri Nandi Statue
places.ai_summary: A monolithic statue of Nandi, the bull, located near the Mysore Palace, and is an important cultural symbol.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning.

places.place_tip: A great spot for photography with the palace in the background.
places.address: Sri Nandi Statue, Mysuru, Karnataka, India

places.name: Jayalakshmi Vilas Mansion
places.ai_summary: A historical mansion showcasing Indo-Saracenic architecture, now converted into a museum.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Explore the museum to learn about the royal heritage of Mysuru.
places.address: Jayalakshmi Vilas Mansion, Mysuru, Karnataka, India

places.name: Shuka Vana Parrot Park
places.ai_summary: A unique park dedicated to the conservation of parrots, featuring a variety of parrot species.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Learn about parrot conservation efforts.
places.address: Shuka Vana Parrot Park, Mysuru, Karnataka, India

places.name: Melukote Temple Town
places.ai_summary: A historic town with ancient temples, known for its religious significance and scenic beauty.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the winter months.

places.place_tip: Visit the Cheluvanarayana Swamy Temple and enjoy the views.
places.address: Melukote, Pandavapura Taluk, Mandya District, Karnataka, India

places.name: Ranganathaswamy Temple Srirangapatna
places.ai_summary: A significant Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Ranganatha, known for its intricate architecture and serene surroundings.

opening_hours.notes: Participate in the temple rituals for a spiritual experience.

places.place_tip: Explore the temple complex and attend the aarti.
places.address: Ranganathaswamy Temple, Srirangapatna, Karnataka, India
